subject.description: what was covered, and which products when the subject was a company or a category

quiet.description: true when there were too few first-hand posts to form a theme: themes is then empty

themes.description: ranked by volume first, then severity

theme.description: the issue, praise or need in one line

product.description: which product it is about, when the subject covers several

status.description: against the previous report's themes; new when there is none

volume.description: an approximate count with its basis, such as about 6 of 40 App Store reviews read, Nov 2 to 9. Never a census

sample_size.description: how many posts you read for this source or theme

severity.description: data loss, billing errors and lockouts are high at any volume

version_link.description: the release this ties to when dates support it, else the words unconfirmed

vendor_response.description: what the vendor said, labelled as the vendor's claim; null when nothing

text.description: verbatim, never paraphrased inside the quote

url.description: that post or review's own link, not the listing page

source.description: such as app store, hacker news, reddit, trustpilot

contrast.description: one paragraph comparing against the competitors given, from the same sources and window; null when none were given

suspected_fake.description: bursts of near-identical text, disclosed free products, review gating; excluded from every count

sources.description: every source tried, with what was read

detail.description: posts read, or why it could not be read: blocked, needs javascript, error

report_markdown.description: what a person reads: the top themes with their quotes and volumes, what is new, the contrast if any, and one line on sources not read
